whatsNew:
Lighter on your connection, and Projects made simpler

Photos in a chat load as small previews, so chats open faster and use far less data. Opening, copying or saving a photo still gives you the full picture.
A slow connection no longer makes Gist say it is offline, and a photo whose sending stalls is tried again by itself.
Projects show just their names; each one's files are behind its ⋯. Tapping a project's name saves into it and shows only that project's conversation; Show all brings the whole chat back. A reply joins the project of the message it answers.
Downloaded photos go to your photo library.

Please check

- Scroll back through a chat with photos: they should appear quickly.
- Tap a project's name, then Show all.
- Download a photo and find it in Photos.
